notes: Positions are approximate: x runs front (0) to rear, y runs from the near/front side (0) to the far side (3); the booklet's isometric drawings do not fix exact stud cells, so I estimated them.

Remaining 2 groups are real, not a defect. The tractor is one connected build. The other group is the shovel p39 on its own. It is a minifigure accessory: the booklet's step 1 and final picture show it held in the minifig's hand, and it is never attached to the tractor. The minifig (cap, head, torso, legs) is not in the PIECE LIST, so nothing in the graph could hold the shovel. I kept it unconnected rather than invent a join the booklet doesn't show.
p21 (dark gray Plate 1x2, part 4211063) is placed at step 15 as a small piece on the front headlight bracket p46. Its exact spot is a guess, so it has no grid position.

The under-plates p16, p19 and the front wheel-holder p49 are joined to the Technic bricks they clutch under (p40/p41). The rear wheels, the rear bucket sub-assembly and the ladder/column sub-assemblies are linked to the chassis through other_joins. Their joins are in other_joins because they clip, pin or attach sideways rather than rest on top.

Step numbering counts the minifig assembly as step 1, every numbered sub-assembly step as its own step, and every numbered main step in order. Main steps 16 and 19 add no new pieces beyond their sub-assemblies, so they appear as steps 24 and 31 with no pieces.

Piece-to-part mapping was inferred from the part-number page and may be off for similar parts. The two angled connectors p26/p27 sit on the bar p22 at the rear. The black pole-reversers p70/p71 belong to the bucket sub-assembly.
p74 (sticker sheet) has one id but is used twice (hood in step 20, grille in the last step). It is recorded once, at step 20, with no grid position.
The bracket sub-assembly in steps 9-11 is built off the model and is then fitted in main step 12. Its piece steps are 9-11 and its rests_on lists only pieces from the same or earlier steps.
